whatItFakes: How fast closeness fades without contact for friends and relatives.
why: No study reports a half-life for closeness without contact; Roberts and Dunbar (2015) give direction only, and 18 months is their study's length. Tagged TUNABLE (CTO, October 10, 2026). Resolved by Oct 12 research (OPUS-PEOPLE): the half-lives are ESTIMATED from Roberts and Dunbar 2015 inner-layer retention (526 and 1,078 days derived, against 548 and 1,095 used; the kin value now equals P15's 1,095) with Mollenhorst, Volker and Flap 2014 as the seven-year check.
replacement: A half-life calibrated against network turnover over years (for example Mollenhorst, Volker and Flap 2014, once checked), the target P15 uses. Done Oct 12 (OPUS-PEOPLE): both half-lives ESTIMATED from Roberts and Dunbar (2015) with Mollenhorst, Volker and Flap (2014) as the long-run check.
